page: Microsoft Azure NV4ads_V710_v5 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine from the NVadsV710v5 family designed to support light visualization and graphics-focused applications. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance provides 4 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an AMD processor. It features 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB allocated per core.

Hardware acceleration is delivered through a fractional AMD V710 GPU providing approximately one-sixth of a full graphics processor alongside 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance also includes 275 GB of local NVMe SSD storage for high-speed temporary file operations and local scratch space, alongside capability for Azure Premium Storage. It does not provision complimentary public IPv4 addresses directly.

By partitioning a physical AMD V710 GPU into smaller fractional slices, the NV4ads_V710_v5 provides a cost-efficient resource model for environments that require dedicated GPU capability without the expense of an entire discrete card. The configuration is appropriate for virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), lightweight 3D modeling, basic CAD applications, interactive graphics workstations, and entry-level video rendering.

Acceleration is provided by a fractional AMD V710 GPU partition offering 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. In addition to support for Premium Storage, the server comes bundled with 275 GB of local NVMe SSD storage for low-latency scratch disk operations and caching. While it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, its partitioned hardware configuration enables efficient utilization of GPU resources without requiring the overhead of an entire discrete graphics card. The NV4ads_V710_v5 is suited for remote desktop visualization, virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), light 3D rendering, and entry-level CAD or computer graphics workloads.
